source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Corvette Body, p.1B-46

procedures.title: Folding top header weatherstrip: replace
steps: (continuing) ...fasteners as shown in figure 81 in the manual, together with neoprene base weatherstrip cement.
notes: Figure 80 in the manual shows the side rail weatherstrip between the #3 bow and rear bow with its cement point.

procedures.title: Sport coupe (19437) roof panels: adjust
steps: Adjust the 2 inner lances (floating mounts received at the center strut) fore/aft and in/out by loosening their 2 hex screws.
Set lance height by adding or removing shims.
Adjust the front outboard locating pins the same way, except no shims are used.
For contour alignment at the outer rear corner, loosen the floating notched receiver and move it until aligned.
For spacing, turn the triangular attachment bolt at the upper rear pillar to move the panel fore or aft.
Move the front and rear holding locks fore or aft within their slotted mounting holes.

procedures.title: Sport coupe roof panel headlining: replace
steps: Remove the 2 screws on each side.
Release the plastic fasteners around the panel edge.

procedures.title: Sport coupe roof panel weatherstrip and front drip molding: replace
steps: Remove the screws at each end of the weatherstrip.
Pry out the plastic clips along its length.
The front drip molding is a press fit: pull it outward carefully to replace it.

procedures.title: Sport coupe interior trim panels: remove and install
steps: Rear window trim panel: pull outward carefully at the plastic fasteners to remove.
To install it, align the 2 locating pins first, then push in the plastic fasteners.
Rear quarter trim panel: remove the 4 screws at both ends and next to the rear roof headlining.
Rear roof trim panel: remove the rear window lock assemblies, then 2 screws and the remaining 4 screws along the roof.

procedures.title: Sport coupe rear window storage tray: replace and adjust
steps: Remove the hinge screws at the rear body panel, or at the hinge strap to the tray.
Adjust the latch by bending it until it engages properly.
notes: The tray holds the rear window assembly when it is out of the car.

procedures.title: Sport coupe rear window glass: replace
parts: rear window frame (upper and lower members)
steps: Take the rear window assembly out of the car and lay it on a bench.
With a small rod or nail under 1/16" diameter, carefully drive out the dowel pins at both frame corners.
Separate the lower frame member from the old glass and frame.
Remove the glass from the upper frame member and scrape the old sealer out of the groove all around the frame.
Run a bead of caulking (polysulfide or equivalent) in the slot of both frame pieces.
Set the new glass into the curved frame member.
Fit the lower member to the glass and reinstall the dowel pins.
Wipe excess caulking off the glass.

procedures.title: Sport coupe rear window: adjust and replace weatherstrip
steps: Move the locks and lower receiving plates within their slotted mounting holes to get an even, adequate seal.
Replace the weatherstrip between the rear window and body opening by cementing it to the rear inner body surface around the opening.
notes: The locks and receiving plates set the holding force.
